title: Nazrul Islam v. U.P. Power Corporation
coram: Sunil Ambwani, J.; Virendra Singh, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; relegated to Para 6.5 bill-objection remedy.
headnote: A writ challenging the correctness of a consumption bill was dismissed because Para 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 already gives the consumer a right to object to the bill.
facts: Nazrul Islam filed Writ-C No. 59691 of 2009 in the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation and others, challenging the correctness of a consumption bill raised by respondent no. 2. Counsel for the petitioner was heard. Shri Pankaj Kumar Shukla appeared for the respondents. The order records no particulars of the connection, meter, or bill amount.

holding_units.holding: A consumer who challenges the correctness of a consumption bill has a right to raise objections under Para 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; a writ petition on that score is dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.

not_decided.note: Writ dismissed without examining the bill on merits.
